title: euodia ruticarpa var. bodinieri
intro: Euodia ruticarpa var. bodinieri, commonly known as Bodinier's Euodia, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family, native to China. It has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties and health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral activities, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throat, and respiratory infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and expectorant effects, which can aid in relieving pain, reducing muscle spasms, and promoting the removal of mucus from the lungs. Euodia ruticarpa var. bodinieri contains bioactive constituents such as limonoids, coumarins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
